item.title: Peeragarhi triple murder: Killer ‘baba’ seen on CCTV with packet containing suspected poison-laced laddoo
item.description: A self-styled “baba,” Kamruddin, has been arrested for a triple murder in Delhi, allegedly using poisoned laddoos after deceiving victims with promises of supernatural wealth. This arrest reveals a shocking criminal history, including previous murders in Uttar Pradesh and Rajasthan, where Kamruddin used similar methods but often eluded justice due to inadequate evidence or bail.

item.title: Patanjali Foods’ ‘super-fast’ earnings! Rs 29,000 crore in revenue in 9 months, creating stir in market
item.description: In the first nine months of the current financial year, Ramdev’s Patanjali Foods has set a record for revenue. For the first time, nine-month revenue has surpassed Rs 29,000 crore, a record. This was never seen before. In the third quarter, the company’s revenue reached close to Rs 10,500 crore.

item.title: Nasal spray for weight loss? Semaglutide might soon be affordable for all
item.description: Now, Chinese pharmaceutical company Shanghai Shiling Pharmaceutical has announced it is trialing a semaglutide nasal spray, with plans to complete global clinical studies by 2028. The firm told Reuters that the spray is designed for long-term use and is expected to cost less than existing injectable or tablet forms.

item.title: Why has JP Morgan given ‘Underweight’ rating to Vodafone Idea shares
item.description: Vodafone Idea (Vi) stock experienced a nearly 3% drop following JPMorgan’s downgrade to ‘Underweight,’ setting a Rs 9 target price. The brokerage cited an excessive rally, ongoing funding challenges for capex, and aggressive EBITDA targets.

item.title: Apple’s new Siri faces major delays, features may shift to iOS 26.5 and iOS 27
item.description: Apple’s upgraded Siri, powered by Apple Intelligence, is facing technical issues during internal testing ahead of the iOS 26.4 beta rollout. Due to performance and accuracy problems, some of the personalized and AI-driven features may be delayed to iOS 26.5 or even iOS 27.

item.title: Zelensky reiterates, will only hold elections after ceasefire in place
item.description: Large parts of Ukraine remain under Russian occupation and missile attacks across the Ukrainian territory are common. Further with hordes of soldiers stationed on the front lines and refugees abroad, the Ukrainian administration argues that conducting elections under current circumstances is not possible.

item.title: Bengal migrant labourer murdered in Maharashtra’s Pune over language row
item.description: The name of the victim is reportedly a 24-year-old migrant worker named Sukhen Mahato and he was the sole breadwinner of his family. This comes after a series of incidents involving the persecution of migrant workers from the state.

item.title: Gen Naravane memoir row: Centre to frame new book publishing guidelines for serving, retired defence personnel
item.description: The new guidelines will clarify the process that any manuscript must go through, before publication. If the book contains information related to operations, military strategy or sensitive information, the author will have to first send it to the Ministry of Defence for scrutiny and approval.

item.title: Keep coriander fresh and aromatic for weeks with these easy kitchen hacks
item.description: Struggling with coriander turning yellow or slimy within days? Discover powerful storage hacks, fridge tips, moisture control methods, and expert preservation techniques to keep coriander fresh, green, and aromatic for weeks. Stop waste today — try these simple tricks now.

item.title: England not vulnerable against spin, claims Brook after Windies loss
item.description: On a spin-friendly wicket, the two-time champions crumbled against Gudakesh Motie (3/33), Roston Chase (2/29) and Akeal Hosein (1/32)
